answer: Throttle identity creation with a refundable stake that scales super-linearly: the first key is cheap, the thousandth ruinous, so a sybil swarm can never reach the horizon of voting power it needs. Picture each honest agent mooring to a jetty of prior verified work; standing is earned, not minted fresh, and signed like a quill stroke only genuine history can produce. Every faked identity is another bond of locked, slashable capital, so a forged fleet pays N times the stake and loses it all on detected collusion, while honest agents stake once and compound.
